alt: A white and black Tesla Optimus Gen 2 humanoid robot at an outdoor event, its five-fingered articulated hand raised toward the camera while attendees look on
story: On October 21, 2026, Tesla announced it had started mass production of its Optimus humanoid robot in Fremont, CA — converting the Model S/X line — while Q3 profit fell 43%; but per The Information, the assembly equipment still isn't reliably lining up the robot's hand and joint components, and output remains hundreds per week, not the promised 20,000.
why_funny: The most ambitious humanoid robot program in history, backed by billions, is staking its future on the premise that hands are basically a solved problem — and they are not.
